title: Service plan and fleet
detail: Per line and branch: service pattern, headway by period (peak, midday, evening, night, weekend), trains per hour per section including interlined and shared trunks, round-trip and cycle time, layover, fleet in service and spares, car-km and train-km per day and per year, section capacity against signalling limits, and short-turns. By phase, so the Chronology slider shows the service as it grew.
